scene.speaker: astrid
scene.bubble: Look at the square: a man with a dog, a woman with flowers, three children playing… and one puffin watching!
scene.intro: Astrid and Nico sit in the square and look at the people. There is a man with a big dog. There is a woman with yellow flowers. There are three children playing with a ball, and there is a baby sleeping in his mother's arms. A man, a woman, a boy, a girl — every person has a story. Who can YOU see in your street? Sit down and look with them!

data.script: Astrid: Look at the square! A man is walking with a big white dog. … Nico: And a woman has got red flowers. Many flowers! … Astrid: Three children are playing with a ball. … Nico: A baby is sleeping in a little car. So small! … Astrid: The ice cream man has a blue hat. … Nico: How many people in the square? … Astrid: One, two… ten people! And one Pip.
